subject: Adding error bars causing R to crash

messages.author: 2858f4dd168fd92d
messages.subject: Adding error bars causing R to crash
parts:
Hi,
It doesn't appear as if my previous post worked so apologies if this appears twice.
I'm trying to put error bars on line graphs, however when I try to do so R crashes. I've tried this on different datasets, I've tried tried reinstalling R, I've tried installing previous versions of R. I've also tried putting error bars on different styles of graphs (bar charts) however in each case when I try to add on the error bars R crashes. The following is example code that causes R to crash. It is taken from Andy Field's book Discovering Statistics with R. The data file, hiccup.dat, can be found here http://www.sagepub.com/dsur/study/DSUR%20Data%20Files/Chapter%204/Hiccups.dat
chickflick.dat can be found here: http://www.sagepub.com/dsur/study/DSUR%20Data%20Files/Chapter%204/ChickFlick.dat


hiccupsData <- read.delim("Hiccups.dat",  header = TRUE)
hiccups<-stack(hiccupsData)
names(hiccups)<-c("Hiccups","Intervention")
hiccups$Intervention_Factor<-factor(hiccups$Intervention, levels(hiccups$Intervention)[c(1, 4, 2, 3)])

library(ggplot2)

line <- ggplot(hiccups,  aes(Intervention_Factor, Hiccups))
line + stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point")+ labs(x = "Intervention", y = "Mean Number of Hiccups") + stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "line", aes(group=1),colour = "Red", linetype = "dashed")
line + stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2)  ### This causes R to crash

chickFlick = read.delim("ChickFlick.dat",  header = TRUE)

bar <- ggplot(chickFlick, aes(film, arousal))
bar + stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "bar", fill = "White", colour = "Black") + labs(x = "Film", y = "Mean Arousal")
bar + stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "pointrange") ### This causes R to crash


I've used this code in the past successfully. I have not tried installing a previous version of ggplot as I don't know how to do this.
Any help would be greatly appreciated as I use this style of graph fairly often.
Thanks
Micah

messages.author: 1bdde74858488643
messages.subject: Re: Adding error bars causing R to crash
parts:
Hey Micah,
Try reinstalling the package "Hmisc" for R (if you are still using Andy Field's book, he describes it as a requirement for these kinds of commands, see chapter 4.9.1.1 Bar charts for one independent variable):

> install.packages("Hmisc")

This worked fine for me. Hope I could still help!
Florian
